output.question: What are Disney's latest financial statements?

key_facts.fact: Disney's latest financial statements are for fiscal Q3 2026 (quarter ended June 27, 2026), reported August 5, 2026 via an 8-K earnings release (Exhibit 99.1).
Disney filed its Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 27, 2026 with the SEC on August 5, 2026.
Q3 FY26 revenues were $25,248 million, up 7% from $23,650 million; nine-month revenues were $76,397 million, up 6% from $71,961 million.
Q3 FY26 income before income taxes was $3.6 billion, up 14%; total segment operating income was $5,555 million, up 21% (nine months: $14,758 million, up 5%).
Q3 FY26 GAAP diluted EPS was $1.51 (down 48% from $2.92); adjusted EPS (excluding certain items) was $2.06, up 28% from $1.61. Nine-month diluted EPS was $4.12.
Q3 FY26 net income attributable to Disney was $2,638 million (nine months: $7,287 million, vs $11,091 million a year earlier).

Q3 FY26 segment revenues: Entertainment $11,345 million (+6%), Sports $4,500 million (+4%), Experiences $9,968 million (+10%); segment operating income: Entertainment $1,680 million (+64%), Sports $858 million (-17%), Experiences $3,017 million (+20%).
Total assets were $204,740 million at June 27, 2026, up from $197,514 million at September 27, 2025.
Q3 FY26 free cash flow was $3,072 million (up 63%); nine-month free cash flow was $5,735 million (down 24%).

Full-year fiscal 2026 guidance: cash provided by operations of at least $19 billion and capital expenditures of approximately $9 billion; Q4 total segment operating income of $4.9 billion including ~$600 million from the 53rd week.

Disney will host its Q4 FY26 earnings webcast covering fiscal full year and fourth quarter 2026 financial results on Tuesday, November 17, 2026 at 8:30 a.m. ET — full-year FY26 statements are not yet released.
